J2 62d9 GATES GREEN AND CLOSED.
 - Full suite: 7533 passed / 29 skipped / 114 deselected, and 2 FAILED on a stale docs/env-vars.md. I did NOT assume it was unrelated: I created a pristine worktree at origin/main and ran the generator check there, which came back CLEAN, proving my change caused it. Cause was benign — that generated doc records LINE NUMBERS, and my outbound_fields.py edit shifted an os.environ.get site from line 30 to line 41. Regenerated with scripts/gen_env_registry.py (the repo's own prescribed fix); both tests then passed.
 - TEST CONSOLIDATION: the implementer had independently written 3 test files (import_contract, no_shims, acli_status_resolution_pin; 275 lines) that duplicated my held-out oracle. I mapped every one of their assertions to a stronger equivalent in mine (mine walk the whole engine, check single-definition by IDENTITY not equality, carry a teeth test, and prove the absolute imports under by-path load), ported the ONE assertion mine lacked (a _loader.py not-relocated guard), then deleted the duplicates. Coverage strictly preserved. Re-ran tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/: 1507 passed. make lint clean.
 - Commit 0c8d39260, 19 files, +1132/-229. Trailers verified: rebar-ticket 62d9 + Change-Id + Signed-off-by RebarBotNava. rebar verify-commit-ticket -> OK. Commit message passes the repo's enforced 50/72 rule.
 - GERRIT CHANGE 1010 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1010), stacked on J1's merged 1009/7fc96b277. Earned LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments, submittable=True.
 - CLOSED 62d9 -> UNBLOCKED 0a94 (J4) and aac8 (J3).
 - NOT YET SUBMITTED: per the skill, the stack lands together at the end (Phase 6) once the epic closes. 1010 stays open on Gerrit as the base of the stack; J3/J4 commit on top of it in my worktree.
NEXT: J3 aac8 (RichTextCodec) and J4 0a94 (UserIdentityModel) are both unblocked and are SIBLINGS of each other (neither depends on the other), so their plan reviews can safely run in parallel without the dependency-staleness hazard. J5 c97f is independent and already plan-review PASSED.
